correctness.rationale: The 27 divisor classes span Picard and the anticanonical class A is primitive, so its inverse image is saturated of rank 21. Reconstructed the 45 tritangents directly from the two standard types and the Steiner grids by testing transversals of disjoint rows, rather than reusing the frozen program's partition-multiplicity test. A new exact Smith computation in /workspace/branches/reproduce_steiner_independent.py found 45 and 120 columns and invariant factors 1^21,0^6 and 1^20,3,0^6, respectively. The grid condition is the geometric conjugacy condition: a distinct tritangent cannot contain two lines of another tritangent, because they uniquely determine their common plane. The frozen same-row determinant method also has the right logic: the unit minor identifies the whole saturated target, the +3 minor bounds the relative index, and every grid maps to 3A under pi, giving the opposite bound by a surjective mod-three map. These are universal finite configurations in the stated characteristic-zero geometric setting, not a sample of surfaces. Read, but did not execute, the frozen verifier.

evidence: The index of im C in Z^45 is 3 times 2^22. Applying B makes L_Tr/(2L_St) its quotient, and [L_Tr:2L_St]=2^21 [L_Tr:L_St]. Hence the desired index divides 6 and is divisible by 3 by the anticanonical coefficient.

If the index were 6, L_Tr/L_St would have a canonical quotient of order two. The symmetry on all tritangents is transitive: label permutations suffice within each of the two types, and the reflection in H-E1-E2-E3 takes {E1,L14,Q4} to {L23,L14,L56}. This standard configuration symmetry preserves Steiner supports.

The induced invariant nonzero functional L_Tr→Z/2 must be 1 on every tritangent generator, hence is the coefficient of A modulo 2. It takes value 1 on each grid (class 3A), contrary to vanishing on L_St.
